notes.title: Big update/ fix our problems
notes.content:
Hello,
We are releasing a new update that will help you master puzzles much faster.
Special thanks for feedback "[KOR] Hong-Gil-Dong"!
We fixed such bugs / shortcomings on our part:
1. Now before the memory game, you will observe 10 seconds all the elements of the game (panties).
2. Now, when playing stone, scissors, paper, the panel does not move anywhere.
3. Puzzle elements move 2 times faster.
4. Updated logic for win scenarios and lose scenarios.
5. Updated engine, delete old code, refactored code for new solution, game playing faster!
